note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Extra keys (note, followup, manual_prepare, manual_teardown) are for the recorder person; the kit ignores them. DATAVERSE_URL must point at the Sales trial environment (trial ends about 21 Dec 2026). Every python command opens its own MSAL interactive sign-in (the token cache is in memory): the owner signs in as labadmin when the browser asks, or exports the app-registration variables in the shell before recording (never in a file).
prepare: if (-not $env:DATAVERSE_URL) { throw 'Set $env:DATAVERSE_URL to the lab environment URL in this shell first (the owner does this; it is never written in a file).' }
manual_prepare: Confirm labadmin is in System Administrator in the Sales trial environment (otherwise pac admin self-elevate, owner signed in).
Assign System Administrator to alex.demo, sam.demo, jordan.demo and riley.demo; optionally disable riley.demo.
Run adminkit admins, settings and jobs once; write down the current audit values for teardown.

steps: Manage, Environments, Sales trial, Settings, Users + permissions, Security roles, System Administrator, Members
Compare with the terminal list (people, application users, teams)

manual_teardown: Restore the audit values noted in setup (audit-on --days <old> --apply restores retention only; switch auditing off in Audit settings if it was off).
Remove System Administrator from alex.demo, sam.demo, jordan.demo, riley.demo; re-enable riley.demo if disabled.
